mentions.name: Brands
mentions.description: A DiffUI feature that lets users establish a design system as a Brand and consistently generate UI designs with it. The author demonstrated it by creating a Brand from the recent UFO files release, and the demo brand can be tried without an account.
mentions.source_excerpt: I recently release Brands for diffui, which let you establish a design system and consistently generate with it. I made a Brand out of the recent UFO files release, which allow for some really fun designs:
